newsitem.title: CHINA: Shougang Concord places 100 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Shougang Concord places 100 mln new shrs.

text.p: Shougang Concord International Enterprises Co Ltd said on Monday it would issue 100 million new shares to parent Shougang Holding (Hong Kong) Ltd after its parent placed out 151 million existing company shares.
The company said Shougang Holding would place the existing company shares at HK$1.78 each to third party investors before subscribing for the new shares at placing price net of expenses.
Shougang Concord shares ended at HK$1.99 on Friday.
On completion of the placement and subscription on July 23, Shougang Holding's stake in the company will be reduced to 38.68 percent from 44.01 percent, the statement said.

Of the proceeds from the subscription of about HK$172.5 million after expenses, about HK$72.5 million will be used to reduce short-term bank borrowings and HK$100 million will go to working capital, it said.
